meta.title: D-SAP Ghule Tutorials | IIT JEE coaching, powered by Kota
meta.description: JEE Main and Advanced coaching in Pune, powered by a top coaching institute in Kota. Faculty from Kota. Centres in New Sangvi and Wakad.

h1: IIT JEE coaching in Pune, powered by Kota

intro.text: D-SAP Ghule Tutorials runs its JEE programme with a top coaching institute in Kota. Faculty from Kota teach here, so your child gets Kota coaching and still lives at home.

intro: Classes run {{fact:batch.days}}, from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}, at our centres in New Sangvi and Wakad.

sections.heading: From Kota to Pune
body: Many families in Pune think about sending their child to Kota for JEE. That means a hostel, a new city and two years away from home.

body.text: Here the Kota programme comes to your child instead. They sleep at home, eat at home and keep their school.
Physics, Chemistry and Maths are taught by faculty who have taught in Kota. Their names, subjects and years of teaching are below.
This is a real class at one of our centres, taught on an AI-powered digital board. Press play to watch it.
Watch the live lecture online, or each class recording whenever you need to. Post on our doubt forum or get it cleared directly with a teacher during a doubt session.
Weekly practice sheet to keep your preparation on track. Computer-Based Tests (CBT) on our online portal, designed to give you the same experience as the actual JEE exam.

sections.heading: Try a test the way JEE sets it
body: JEE Main is taken on a computer. There is a timer, a panel of question numbers and a button to mark a question for review. Try a short test below and see your score as soon as you submit.

body.text: Our tests run on the same kind of screen, so the real exam feels familiar.

sections.heading: Every test, read back to you

body.text: Every test on the portal comes back with a personal analysis of how your child did. The report below is an example.
You also meet the teachers at parent-teacher meetings, so you hear about progress from the people who teach.

sections.heading: The JEE syllabus, chapter by chapter
body: Physics, Chemistry and Maths for JEE Main and Advanced, one chapter to a line, each with a code like 11-P-03. Open a chapter to see what it covers. The [full syllabus](page:jee-syllabus) has every chapter.

body.text: The programme starts in June after Class 10, with a foundation period from April. Class 11 builds the base in all three subjects. In Class 12, a JEE Advanced mock every quarter joins the monthly JEE Main mock.

sections.heading: Where we teach
body: Both centres are in Pimpri-Chinchwad, close to Aundh, Baner and Balewadi. Pick your area to see the way to the nearest centre.

body.text: A two-year programme for students starting Class 11, a one-year programme for Class 12, and a foundation programme for Class 9 and 10.

sections.heading: Results
body: Each result here names the exam, the year and the programme the student took with us.

questions.q: Is this the same coaching as in Kota?

a.text: We are affiliated with a top coaching institute in Kota, and faculty from Kota teach here. [Powered by Kota](page:powered-by-kota) explains what comes from Kota and what we add in Pune.
Students who have passed Class 10 from any board (SSC, CBSE or ICSE) can join the two-year programme. Class 12 students can join the one-year programme.

questions.a: Classes run from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}, after school.

a.text: There is a test after every chapter, a longer test every fourth week and a full JEE Main mock every month. Class 12 students also take a JEE Advanced mock every quarter.

questions.q: How many students are in a batch?
questions.a: A batch has at most {{fact:batch.size}} students.
Fees depend on the programme. Call us on {{fact:contact.phone}} and we will explain them, or ask at either centre.
